annotations.title: Find company in Peppol e-invoicing network

description: Looks up a company in Peppol, the network for e-invoices. Search by VAT ID (for an EU VAT ID or a Swiss UID the Peppol identifiers are derived from it automatically and the answer names them, and for a UK VAT ID with 9 or 12 digits after GB those of scheme 9932; from an XI VAT ID none is derived, and the status is unsupported), by a known Peppol participant ID, or by company name. Returns two parts: the Peppol Directory (where listing is voluntary) and, for a VAT ID or participant ID, the Peppol network itself (SML and the provider's SMP), which also finds companies that are not listed in the directory. For each identifier in invoices_confirmed_for, the provider's SMP ServiceGroup lists a recognised invoice type; this does not prove delivery. A listing in the directory, reachable: true, 'registered' without confirmed (only an SML entry), or 'registered' with confirmed: true but no invoice type among the documents the SMP lists is not such a confirmation. The documents are given per identifier, and so is a lookup that did not answer; that is not 'not registered'. 'not registered' only covers the identifiers looked up; the company may use another one. A name search asks the directory only and confirms no invoice type.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code for a name search.

name.description: Company name, if neither VAT ID nor participant ID is known.

participant_id.description: A known Peppol participant ID: four-digit scheme code, colon, identifier, e.g. 0208:0202239951. If participant_id is given, vat_id and name are ignored.

vat_id.description: The company's VAT ID or Swiss UID. If vat_id is given, name is ignored.

name: find_peppol_participant
